# avd_current_state_facts.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

AVD Current State Facts -- turns collector and validator evidence packages into one redacted facts snapshot (avd-current-state-facts/v1) for avd-second-brain and avd-swarm.

The collector and validator packages hold tenant data: subscription and object IDs, resource names, user principal names, IP addresses, tags. They feed the customer's private estate vault (avd-second-brain contract C1). This script makes the form of the same evidence that the brain's agents read, that a model prompt may hold, and that a playbook proposal to avd-swarm may cite (contract C11): - Allowlisted fields only. Every value is a count, a boolean, a public Azure value (region, VM size, marketplace image, built-in role name, check name) or a keyed pseudonym. Names, IDs, IPs, tags, user names and free text are never copied. - Keyed pseudonyms. Subscriptions, host pools and storage accounts become `sub-3fa2c1d0`, `hp-...`, `st-...`: HMAC-SHA256 of the resource ID with the estate's key. The same key gives the same pseudonyms on every run, so the brain sees trends. Nobody can reverse one without the key and the resource IDs. - A final scan refuses to write the snapshot if anything that looks like a GUID, an email address, a UNC path or a non-documentation IPv4 address got through, and redacts any validator check name that contains a collected resource name. The key is the estate's secret. Keep it with the vault (or, with the landing zone's operations brain, in its Key Vault), never in a repository and never in the snapshot. Losing or rotating it breaks the link to earlier snapshots, by design. Personal project, not for production use. Provided as is, without warranty of any kind (MIT License, see LICENSE). Not affiliated with the author's employer, with Liquidware or with Microsoft. OFFLINE AND LOCAL ------------------------------------------------------------------ Reads package folders and ZIPs from disk and writes one JSON file. No Azure call, no network. Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-PackagePath` | string[] | yes |  | Collector or validator package folders, their ZIPs, or folders that contain them. The latest collector run per subscription and the latest validator run per subscription and mode are used. |
| `-KeyPath` | string | yes |  | File holding the estate's pseudonymization key (base64, 32 bytes). |
| `-NewKey` | switch | no |  | Create the key file when it doesn't exist. Without it a missing key is an error, so a typo can't silently start a new set of pseudonyms. |
| `-OutputPath` | string | no | `(Get-Location).Path` | Folder for avd-current-state-facts-<timestamp>.json. Defaults to the current folder. |
| `-Assess` | switch | no |  | Also run the avd-assess method pinned in assess/ over the snapshot and write avd-assessment-<timestamp>.json (contract C21) beside it: one outcome per check (pass, warn, gap, unknown), the pillar scores with their coverage, and each design decision's readiness. It holds only pseudonyms, fact IDs and outcomes. Nothing is fetched; the method's copy must match its hash in assess/PINS.json. |
| `-IntakePath` | string | no |  | With -Assess, the estate's intake.json (contract C19, written by the assessment portal's Discover stage). It must be for the same estate as the snapshot. Without it, the decisions that need intake answers report needs-intake. |

## Examples

```powershell
.\avd_current_state_facts.ps1 -PackagePath .\avd-current-state-20261015T091500, .\avd-validation-20261016T100000.zip -KeyPath ..\avd-brain\.brain\facts.key -NewKey
```
```powershell
.\avd_current_state_facts.ps1 -PackagePath D:\Assessments -KeyPath ..\avd-brain\.brain\facts.key -OutputPath ..\avd-brain\facts
```
```powershell
.\avd_current_state_facts.ps1 -PackagePath $out -KeyPath (Join-Path $out 'estate.key') -OutputPath $out -Assess -IntakePath (Join-Path $out 'intake.json')
```
